Generous completely transparent padding around each isolated object, no backdrop, no floor or cast shadow, no labels, text, grid lines, people or other furniture. High resolution atlas ideally 2048x1024. Fit objects completely within their cell, no overlap.

Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent contact-calibrated seated character sprite atlas for RoomCrew. Attached sheet is identity and hand-painted style reference ONLY. Preserve this exact green cardigan male assistant, face, hair, clothing, same head size and warm linework. Eight COMPLETE seated full-body sprites, precisely FOUR columns by TWO rows, equal transparent cells with generous gutters, same scale. Orthographic 2:1 office camera, subject rotates, camera fixed. Row-major views: front toward viewer; front-right quarter facing lower-right; right profile facing right; rear-right quarter facing upper-right; straight back; rear-left quarter facing upper-left; left profile facing left; front-left quarter facing lower-left. All eight views physically distinct. Critical contact geometry: sitting naturally on an INVISIBLE low chair, thighs horizontal and knees 90 degrees, SHINS VERTICAL, BOTH SHOE SOLES FLAT ON THE SAME GROUND BASELINE, no dangling feet, no cross-legged pose, no tucked-up legs. Hip is about 0.7 head-width ABOVE the floor. Use consistent 2.5 head chibi proportions; upright centered torso; relaxed shoulders. Rear/back poses hold hands forward at a low desk keyboard height, front poses hands resting loosely on knees; no objects or keyboard painted. Do not draw chair, furniture, shadows outside shoe, floor, background, glow, labels, grid, text or watermark. Actual alpha transparency. The image will be measured for hip and sole sockets, so all legs must be complete, natural ground-contact feet and same hip-to-floor height in all directions. Avoid sitting on air with feet raised; invisible SEAT at hips, feet resting on invisible GROUND. Atlas ideally2048x1024.
